title: randn_like should take a generator.
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.randn.html#torch.randn allows us to bring our own generator but https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.randn_like.html does not which reduces it's convenience. 

### Alternatives

_No response_

### Additional context

_No response_
